content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant exists anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: (c) The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "hire" and "employ" return no restrictive covenant; the only employment-related language is the independent contractor clause (p0066), the confidentiality permission to share with employees/directors (p0061), and the indemnity references to employees/hired third parties (p0047, p0051-p0052). The miscellaneous block (p0064-p0073) contains no non-solicitation or no-hire provision. The agreement therefore imposes no non-solicit on AP, which is the playbook's preferred position, so nothing to redline.
